correctness.rationale: Complete necessity-and-sufficiency proof for all n≥2 from occupied-column interval, domination boundary, minimal internal row switches, and all-vertex deletion obstruction. Mutually disjoint combinatorial decomposition proves exact bivariate rational GF, then Fibonacci coefficients. The original-definition standalone verifier independently exhausts 1,398,087 nonempty subsets for n=2..10 and matches both vertex families; exact GF recurrence checked through n=50. Finite checks are supplementary, not infinite proof.
